Priya (partnerships): Heads-up: CloudFrontier asked for evidence bundle to list us in their gov marketplace: SOC2 summary, third-party firmware pen report, SI attestation, and an artifacts manifest. They want submission by May 3 to hit May 20 launch. Who can own each artifact?
Luca (security): I can own the pen-test redaction + vuln escalation. Need clarity: do they need PoCs or just summary + remediation attestation?
Priya (partnerships): They prefer summary + remediation attestation; PoCs only if NDA in place.
Nora (SI): SI attestation needs OEM confirmation on HSM and key custody. I can draft the attestation once OEM signs. Can someone share OEM contact?
Ibrahim (eng-infra): Ops: artifacts must live in eu-central for the gov marketplace. We can generate presigned links TTL=5d. I'll prepare a bucket template and sample presign command.
Kai (compliance): SOC2 is current; I'll prepare a two-page extract and an evidence manifest CSV (artifact_name, type, path, presign_ttl, redacted). Also add retention statement.
VaultBot: Policy reminder: Unredacted artifacts must be stored in the secure vault. See https://redwood.internal/docs/evidence-upload
Luca (security): I'll run a 1-day internal sanity test on the firmware before handing to vendor. Posting redaction checklist here after vendor plan lands.
Priya (partnerships): Action items: Luca -> redaction + pre-check (due Apr 22), Kai -> SOC2 extract + manifest (due Apr 20), Ibrahim -> presign bucket + policy (due Apr 21), Nora -> attestation draft + OEM contact (due Apr 19). I'll coordinate partner comms and confirm submission window Apr 26. Tag uploads with `cloudfrontier-gov` and prefix filenames with `cf_gov_`.
Priya (partnerships): Quick ask: legal NDA for unredacted access? If needed, we should avoid sending raw PoCs.
Luca (security): Agreed. We'll only provide PoCs behind NDA.
Priya (partnerships): Thanks, team. I'll schedule a 15-min checkin on Apr 18.
